notes.title: "Wukong's immortality in the pool world"
notes.content:
Since the beginning of time, the world has been complicated and strange things have emerged one after another. Amidst the thunder and lightning, Wukong broke into the world of billiards, swinging his club like a sword, dancing with the wind and moving the clouds. In this fantasy, he explored the secret of immortality and experienced the cycle of life and death.

Above the nine heavens, the gods looked down; under the nine netherworlds, Yama was waiting. In this vast world, a unique miracle was performed. The incense was curling, it was better to decide the fate of the world with one shot and tell a legendary story.

The cycle of life and death is the fate of mortals. But in this world of billiards, challenge fate and pursue that extraordinary power. A ball into the pocket shook the world, like the power of thunder.

Today, "Wukong's Pool" ushered in a record low discount of -75%, welcome everyone to come and experience it. May this power accompany you forward!

notes.title: “Wukong's Pool” v1.1 game update
notes.content:
After the game was released, we received a lot of feedback from players. During this period, we made the following optimizations to the gameplay.

[h1]Game Logic Adjustment[/h1]
Now "Wukong's Pool" has adjusted the "single card mode" and "multi-card mode" to "normal mode" and "crazy mode", and the game logic is more unified:
[list]
[*]After the start, the player draws 5 cards per round, and [b]each completed card[/b] will gain a skill upgrade.
[*]If no card is completed in one stroke, 1 health will be deducted.
[*]In the crazy mode, the logic is the same as the normal mode, but the card difficulty will be higher, and random cards will be "cursed".
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044611/8c064e5d5b2d496cd22fb75a0f88ea584cd2db56.gif[/img]
[h1]Difficulty Adjustment[/h1]
In the previous version, the difficulty gradient of the 54 cards was too steep, causing players to feel very frustrated when playing. We have made the following adjustments:
[list]
[*][b]Greatly reduce[/b] the overall difficulty of the cards.
[*]Add a card[b]curse mechanism[/b] to make the game more random in "crazy mode" but not too difficult.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044611/91edcf5f4edced447112b703d8934ec1a85e57c0.gif[/img]
[h1]Content Richness[/h1]
This update also brings more content, including:
[list]
[*]10 card curses.
[*]7 new skills, including new active skills that can interact with hand cards.
[/list]

If you encounter any problems during the game, feel free to report to us at ruizstudiogo@gmail.com.

notes.title: Regarding the penalties for cheaters in "Wukong's Challenge"
notes.content:
After the "Wukong's Challenge" was held, many players actively participated.

But there are also a few cheaters who dominate the list through technical means. In our game, 20-50 points are usually excellent scores, and 100 points or more are top scores, while the scores of cheaters are all over 100,000 points, which seriously affects the gaming experience of ordinary players.

Here, we impose the following penalties on cheaters:
[olist]
[*] Every time a cheater uses their account to open the game, they need to listen to a song "Big Banana" before they can continue the game.
[*] The cheater's avatar in the leaderboard is replaced with "Joker".
[*] Cheaters are not allowed to delete their own records on the leaderboard privately (to warn other cheaters).
[/olist]

In addition, we will hold another challenge at an appropriate time, and we will optimize our anti-cheating system at that time, so please stay tuned!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45044611/de188ceba982a417179d45a4f3dd4341178f7578.png[/img]
